description: This file implements authentication backends for the lighttpd server, including support for htdigest, htpasswd, and plain text authentication. It contains functions for initializing, merging, and applying configuration, as well as handling digest and basic authentication methods, and reading user credential data from specified files.

classes.description: Holds file paths for different authentication credential files used by the plugin.
